SCREENING RESULT — supported vs volunteer. Ratio Christi's own application page states plainly that it runs two Chapter Director tracks: 'Supported Missionary' (paid from funds raised through the director's own Ministry Partners) and volunteer ('tent-maker'), and volunteer applicants skip parts of the application. There is a separate give.ratiochristi.org/volunteer-summary page. This makes the screen structural and clean: the presence of a give.ratiochristi.org/missionary/<name> page IS the supported track. Everyone emitted here has one. No named individual encountered in this slice was described as a volunteer or tent-maker, so zero people were excluded by name; the exclusion was applied by requiring the giving page. Evidence: https://ratiochristi.org/join/application-interview-process/ and https://give.ratiochristi.org/volunteer-summary

SPLIT OBSERVED. Distinct give.ratiochristi.org/missionary pages surfaced across all searches: 43 supported people on 39 pages (4 couple pages split into 8 records). Chapter pages named by search: 13 across give.ratiochristi.org/chapter and chapters.ratiochristi.org (Middle Tennessee State, Missouri, Kentucky, Rutgers, Cincinnati, North Texas, UNC Chapel Hill, Rice, Baylor, Colorado State Fort Collins, Indiana University Indianapolis, Houston Christian, Maryville College), plus 10 more index entries seen in the chapters.ratiochristi.org sample (NC State, UT Austin, Purdue, Texas A&M College Station, Kansas State, Michigan Ann Arbor, Nebraska Lincoln, Maryville, Cincinnati, and the index root). Ratio Christi advertises chapters at a far larger number of campuses than the 39 indexed giving pages, and named directors on chapters.ratiochristi.org (e.g. Tera Stewart, Amy Hardy, Forrest DeVita, Benji Smith, David Gustafson) had NO matching giving page in any search. Read directionally: the supported-missionary roster looks like a minority of the total chapter-director population, and the remainder are either volunteer tent-makers or student/faculty-led chapters. Treat the giving-page roster as the addressable set and do not extrapolate the chapter count into prospects.

Exhaustion: the final two exclusion sweeps returned identical result sets with the negative operators visibly dropped, and three consecutive searches produced no new person. give.ratiochristi.org/missionary appears to be indexed at roughly 39 pages and that surface is worked out from search alone. Further yield needs the give.ratiochristi.org/missionaries hub or the chapters.ratiochristi.org A-Z index fetched directly, which page fetching blocks here.

Left to sibling slice p-ratio-b (N-Z, leadership, international) rather than duplicated here: Rick Conrad (Aix-en-Provence, France), Corey Miller (national leadership), Steven DiSebastian (Rutgers), Vas Avramidis (Princeton/Rutgers), Jane Pantig (University of Utah), Joe Miller (San Diego campuses), Eric Pement (University of North Florida), Amy Hardy (UT Austin). All have visible give.ratiochristi.org/missionary pages except Pement and Hardy.
